name: @denta/doctor-app
description: Denta Doctor mobile app (Expo). Runs the shared mobile codebase with APP_VARIANT=doctor.

scripts.start: cd ../.. && cross-env APP_VARIANT=doctor EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT=doctor npx expo start --port 8082
scripts.android: cd ../.. && cross-env APP_VARIANT=doctor EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT=doctor npx expo start --android --port 8082
scripts.ios: cd ../.. && cross-env APP_VARIANT=doctor EXPO_PUBLIC_APP_VARIANT=doctor npx expo start --ios --port 8082
